hero.tag: Now Recruiting · Season I — The Awakening
hero.sub: Aetheria is a personal progression system that turns your real life into an immersive RPG. Every habit becomes a quest. Every goal, a boss fight. Every day you show up, your character — and you — grow stronger.

darkness.headline: Most days end the same: tabs, regret, and a checklist that bullied you.
darkness.lead: To-do apps treat you like a database. Calendars treat you like a meeting. Habit trackers shame you in lowercase serif. None of them feel like they are on your side — and so the work piles up, the streaks die, and another week dissolves into noise.
darkness.s1Body: The plan exists. The energy doesn't. You open three apps, close them, scroll, and the morning is gone.
darkness.s2Body: You know what you "should" do. You don't know what to do first. Everything is medium-urgent forever.
darkness.s3Body: A 19-day streak vanishes. No fanfare, no recovery path. Just a quiet hole where the discipline used to live.
darkness.s4Body: "Get fit." "Learn the language." "Finish the book." Same goals, three years running. No felt progress.
darkness.s5Body: You worked 11 hours. You feel nothing. The graph in your head is flat. There is no level, only Tuesday.
darkness.s6Body: 15 reminders, 3 colors, 0 momentum. Tools that organize your overwhelm without ever reducing it.

ascent.headline: Watch a 90-day arc unfold inside one screen.
ascent.lead: Aetheria isn't about willpower — it's about feedback. Tiny daily quests build into visible momentum, and your character starts becoming someone you actually want to be. Here's what the same person looks like across one season.
ascent.s1Note: "Picked a class. Set 3 quests. Felt small, but I closed two of them."
ascent.s2Note: "Hit a 7-day streak. Got a first achievement. The dopamine is real."
ascent.s3Note: "My weeks have a rhythm now. The dashboard knows me. I show up before I think."
ascent.s4Note: "I'm not the same person. The character on screen finally caught up to the one in my head."

system.headline: Three loops. One emerging hero.
system.lead: Underneath the cinematic theming is a serious engine: a daily quest loop, a long-arc progression layer, and an in-world reward economy that ties them together. Each one is fun on its own. Together they're how transformation actually compounds.
system.questDesc: Bring in real-life tasks — workouts, deep work, study, errands. Aetheria ranks them by difficulty, weights the XP, and arranges them into a single, calm play queue.
system.levelDesc: Every completion ripples into character stats, streak multipliers, and a long XP arc visible at a glance. You stop measuring time in days and start measuring it in progress.
system.rewardDesc: Spend earned coins on real-world rewards you defined (a coffee, an hour off, a new book) and unlock cosmetic loot, character classes, and rare badges in the Vault.

arsenal.headline: Every tool you've used. Re-imagined as one living system.
arsenal.lead: Calendar, to-do, habit tracker, journal, mood log — they all collapse into one interface that's coherent, deep, and built for someone who actually wants to change.
arsenal.qsTitle: Tasks reframed as battles worth winning.
arsenal.qsDesc: Difficulty ranks (S→D), party quests with friends, recurring chains, and built-in penalty contracts for the ones you keep dodging.
arsenal.schedTitle: An itinerary that respects your energy.
arsenal.schedDesc: Aetheria reads your stat curves, past completion times, and energy log — and proposes a single, calm sequence for the day you can actually execute.
arsenal.achDesc: Hand-crafted achievements with story moments. Earned forever — visible on your profile.
arsenal.missionsTitle: A fresh quest line, every dawn.
arsenal.missionsDesc: Three rotating missions with bonus rewards — enough to break monotony, never enough to overwhelm.
arsenal.m3Label: Log every meal of the day
arsenal.focusTitle: A timer that doubles XP under pressure.
arsenal.focusDesc: Lock in a deep-work session. Stay through, get a multiplier. Break early, take the penalty. The honor system, gamified.
arsenal.charTitle: An identity worth showing up for.
arsenal.charDesc: Choose a class. Earn stat points. Unlock skill trees that mirror the kind of human you are becoming.

metrics.headline: Visible momentum. Receipts, not vibes.
metrics.lead: Aetheria's stat engine watches the small stuff so you don't have to: focus minutes, streak depth, quest velocity, recovery time. It's a permanent record of becoming, plotted with the satisfying motion of a great game.
metrics.focusedDelta: ▲ +34h vs last season · 5h above goal pace
metrics.focusedDesc: Tracked across 412 sessions. Aetheria's focus engine logs your most productive blocks and rebuilds your schedule around them.

vault.headline: Loot worth grinding for. Both real and rare.
vault.lead: Two parallel economies, one wallet. Spend your earned coins on real-world rewards you defined for yourself — and chase Vault drops: cosmetic crowns, character classes, badges so rare they leave a mark on your profile forever.
vault.item1Desc: Cosmetic head item. Earned by ranking A or higher for a full season.
vault.item2Desc: Mythic-tier vanity. Pulses with cosmic light during focus sessions.
vault.item3Desc: Off-hand vanity. Glows brighter the longer your active streak grows.
vault.item4Desc: Real-world reward: 4 unscheduled hours, defended by Aetheria from your calendar.

guild.headline: 142,000 heroes. One quiet, focused realm.
guild.lead: Aetheria isn't a feed. There's no infinite scroll, no rage-bait, no follower count. Just a small, optional party system where the only thing you can publish is your own progress.
guild.kaedeQuote: Three months in and I've finally written more than I've doom-scrolled. The quest system did the thing meditation apps couldn't.
guild.ariaQuote: Other apps tracked what I did. Aetheria made me want to do it. The first habit tracker I haven't deleted in shame after six weeks.
guild.toraQuote: I run a 12-person engineering team. We use the Guild feature like a war room. Quiet, focused, no Slack noise. Productivity tripled, vibes intact.

callout.sub: Choose a class. Set three small quests. Watch what happens when the world finally rewards you for the person you've been quietly trying to become.
callout.fineprint: ◆ NO CREDIT CARD · CANCEL ANY TIME · S1 LAUNCHES IN 14 DAYS ◆

footer.brandDesc: A personal progression system. For the people quietly trying to become someone better, in spite of every app that's tried to gamify them into burnout.
